title: Coherent cohomology of a projective scheme over a Noetherian ring
statement:
Let $A$ be Noetherian, let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be
projective, and let
$\mathcal F$ be a coherent module.
Then $H^q(X,\mathcal F)$ is a finite $A$-module for every $q$.
For an embedding $X\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_A$, these groups
vanish for $q>n$.

proof.text: By [def-pc-projective-morphism], choose a closed immersion $i:X\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_A$ over $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ whose composite with the structural projection is the given projective morphism. The standard opens of $\mathbf P^n_A$ are affine polynomial charts by [def-pc-proj], so $\mathbf P^n_A$ is of finite type over the Noetherian scheme $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$; [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] therefore makes $\mathbf P^n_A$ Noetherian and hence locally Noetherian. A closed immersion is locally of finite type, so [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] makes $X$ locally Noetherian. Thus [lem-pc-closed-immersion-coherent-cohomology] applies: $i_*\mathcal F$ is coherent on $\mathbf P^n_A$ and $H^q(\mathbf P^n_A,i_*\mathcal F)\cong H^q(X,\mathcal F)$ for every $q$. The finiteness statement [lem-pc-projective-space-coherent-finiteness] applied to $i_*\mathcal F$ gives that $H^q(X,\mathcal F)$ is a finite $A$-module. For the vanishing clause, let $j:X\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^m_A$ be any embedding, i.e. a closed immersion over $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ as in [def-pc-projective-morphism] (not necessarily the $i$ chosen above). The same argument with $j$ in place of $i$ ($\mathbf P^m_A$ is Noetherian by the chart argument, and $X$ is locally Noetherian as shown) lets [lem-pc-closed-immersion-coherent-cohomology] give that $j_*\mathcal F$ is coherent, hence quasi-coherent, with $H^q(X,\mathcal F)\cong H^q(\mathbf P^m_A,j_*\mathcal F)$; for $q>m$, [lem-pc-projective-space-cohomology-bound] makes the right side zero, hence $H^q(X,\mathcal F)=0$ (equivalently, its additive group is subsingleton).
